measure.measure_definition: Measured value: total PSQI score at baseline and after 8 weeks; Participants; PSQI questionnaire administered by WhatsApp video call/message at baseline and 8 weeks; the PSQI has 19 self-rated items grouped into seven components; questionnaires were read verbally to participants and completed by the researcher from verbal answers.; Total score ranges from 0 to 21, with higher scores indicating poorer sleep quality. A score of 5 or higher is typically used as the threshold to identify poor sleep quality.
measure.measure_name: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index total score

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: total ESS score at baseline and after 8 weeks; Participants; ESS questionnaire administered by WhatsApp video call/message at baseline and 8 weeks; 8 questions assess the tendency to sleep during daytime activities; each question is scored from 0 (I never nap) to 3 (I most likely doze off); questionnaires were read verbally to participants and completed by the researcher from verbal answers.; Total ESS score; a score ≤ 5 is considered normal, while a score ≥ 16 indicates severe daytime sleepiness. The supplied text does not state the total maximum explicitly.

Measured value: average FSS score at baseline and after 8 weeks; Participants; FSS questionnaire administered by WhatsApp video call/message at baseline and 8 weeks; 9 items each scored from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree); questionnaires were read verbally to participants and completed by the researcher from verbal answers.; The scale score is obtained by calculating the average of the 9 items. A scale score less than 2.8 is defined as no fatigue, while a score more than 6.1 indicates chronic fatigue.

population.intervention: Home-based telerehabilitation pranayama: Ujjayi, Nadish Dhana, and Sukha pranayama
population.intervention_regimen: Each session 15 min (Ujjayi 5 min, Nadish Dhana 5 min, Sukha 5 min); 3 sessions daily; additional single 15-min supervised online session; Self-practice 3 times daily, 7 days/week for 8 weeks; online supervised sessions 3 times/week for 8 weeks
population.population_definition: Randomization to home-based telerehabilitation pranayama intervention; Adults aged 20–60 years with mild-to-moderate obstructive sleep apnea syndrome diagnosed by overnight polysomnography (AHI 5–14 mild; 15–29 moderate) who met the trial inclusion criteria, provided written consent, and were randomly assigned to the intervention group. Exclusions included CPAP or mandibular advancement device use, additional respiratory disease such as COPD or asthma, need for hypnotic agents, drugs such as beta-blockers affecting the sympathetic nervous system, previous maxillofacial surgery, craniofacial malformation, neurological or psychological disorders, malignancy, decompensated heart failure, diabetes, and severe cognitive impairment.
